task.description: Verify zig build test-integration-svc and zig build test-integration-env each produce a stable, low failure count comparable to the umbrella zig build test-integration, across 3+ consecutive runs, per ISS-0145 acceptance criteria.
acceptance_criteria: 3+ consecutive -svc runs with stable failure count
3+ consecutive -env runs with stable failure count
Failure rate comparable to umbrella test-integration baseline

result.summary: zig build test-integration-svc: 3 consecutive runs, all 476/543 passed (7 skipped, 59 failed, 1 crashed), byte-identical failing-test-name sets in every pairwise diff. zig build test-integration-env: 3 consecutive runs, identical 476/543 result, byte-identical failing-test-name sets, and identical to -svc's failure set. Down from ~291/543 failing pre-fix (GitHub #457's own report). C42P01 errors against tenant_default-scoped tables eliminated. Umbrella zig build test-integration run in same session showed only 3 comparable C42P01 occurrences (against per-test dynamically-provisioned tenant schemas, a different expected mechanism) -- confirms -svc/-env now match the umbrella's own low rate. Remaining 59 stable failures on -svc/-env are a separate, pre-existing, unrelated class (assertion mismatches, allocation leaks) out of scope for this issue.
